brief:
A mosque was set on fire in Israel, with Knesset members characterizing the incident as a hate crime and attributing it to inflammatory rhetoric from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Al Jazeera English reported. Opposition legislators linked the arson to what they described as the premier's pattern of incitement against Palestinians and Arabs.

Hamas blamed Israeli "settler gangs" for the attack, framing it within the broader context of violence against Palestinian communities. The incident drew swift condemnation from Israeli lawmakers, though statements on its cause remained divided along political lines.
dek: Knesset MPs call the incident 'a hate crime' while Hamas blames Israeli 'settler gangs'.
title: Arsonists burn mosque in Israel as politicians cite Netanyahu incitement
